title: alyssum pyrenaicum
intro: Alyssum pyrenaicum, commonly known as Pyrenees sweet Alyssum, is a flowering plant that belongs to the mustard family (Brassicaceae). This plant is used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antiseptic and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Alyssum pyrenaicum include its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a useful remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
